photo_plan.why: Plato 7 Nov: set B is Iyengar's life told with he/his, so no photo where an AYBKK teacher is the main or front figure (B10 had the teacher in front next to "he passed away"). Teacher photos moved to set C.

B.why: Cover WILLING. The widest B room shot: four people, and a man in red shorts climbs up out of a strong backbend ('a WILLING heart climbs each one'). The teacher only watches from the left edge. He is not adjusting, and he is not the main figure.

Its top is at y 90, not 60, so it stays ~35 px under the flowers at x 890-950 (slide y <= 55). Iyengar | 9 steps · swipe'; without it the credit wraps into 4 ragged lines in 353. The block runs from the light grey mat onto the black mat (from ~1140), so sburn 0.4. His raised foot ends at slide ~845. His hand on the grey mat (x ~420-480, y ~1065-1095) stays left of the column. Watermark wmxy [60,1250] on the dark floor, below the teacher's feet. Word wburn 0.25, shadow 1.4.

She is the youngest-looking main student in the B pool. The standing man behind is blurred and not adjusting. The hint's 'first careful Samasthiti' is in no B-eligible photo.

He was born | sick in 1918, then had malaria, | typhoid and tuberculosis.' Block: 60-598, y 216-473. The sentence lines end by x ~570. The one-line credit (x to 598) sits at y ~455-473, below his hand, ~40 px from his body. The default 607 wrap is 604 px wide, and its lines 1-4 would run onto his blurred arm (x 600-650, y 190-400). Flush-right blocks: B5, C1 and C5 use sright on 1020, so their left edges float at x 500, 499 and 526, not on a grid line. B5 and C1 would hit the left watermark logo (ends x ~416) if left-aligned on 413. C5 would hit the teacher's head (needs x >= 470). If Boonchu wants every left edge on a grid line, these three need another layout.

Weakest slides: C6 07-491 (the text sits over the teacher's arm, and the watermark overlaps her forearm); B3 07-591 (weakest image, and the watermark sits right under the blurred upside-down face); B2 07-595 (HELPLESS can only reach bs 122).

Ages: no B-eligible photo shows a 60+ face. After the swaps, B runs: young (2-6), ~50s at 7 EAGER, then the red-shorts man (~40) at 8-9 and a 30s-50s row at 10. The line still dips after 7. This is a known limit for Boonchu, carried by the 'he' thread. C runs 30s+child, 30s, 30s-40s, ~50, 40s, 50s-60s, grey-haired, oldest grey-haired, older man.

Teacher: no set-B main figure is an adjusting teacher. He is visible but not adjusting on B1 07-292 (watching from the left edge) and B10 07-604 (seated, teaching). He is blurred on B2 07-595 and B8 07-808. B6 07-713's far-background adjusting teacher is cropped out at t=270. No older student lies flat on B10 or C9; both are seated.
The same red-shorts man appears on B cover 07-292, B8 CALM 07-808 and B9 LOYAL 07-192 (and on the spare 07-136).
Text with the bottom on 1290 (watermark on the other side): B1, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, C1, C7, C8. Sideways words (wrot -90): B DOUBT, CALM, LOYAL; C SURE, TRUST, OPEN; spare PROUD.
